description: This Java class, OrbitalPaymentServices.java, provides a payment service integration with the Orbital SDK within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for credit card authorization, capture, refund, release, and related transaction processing, utilizing Orbital SDK request and response interfaces. The class manages configuration, transaction initiation, processing responses, and error handling for payment transactions

classes.name: OrbitalPaymentServices
classes.description: A service class providing methods for processing credit card transactions through the Orbital SDK using OFBiz framework conventions. It manages request building, transaction processing, response handling, and configuration setup for payment operations such as authorization, capture, refund, and release.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Performs credit card authorization using Orbital SDK, constructs request, validates, processes transaction, and handles response.

methods.name: ccAuthCapture
methods.description: Performs authorization and immediate capture for credit card payment, with request setup, validation, processing, and response handling.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Captures previously authorized transaction amount, constructs request, validates, processes, and handles response.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Issues a refund for a given transaction, setting up request, validation, processing, and response management.

methods.name: ccRelease
methods.description: Reverses or releases a prior authorization, with request setup, validation, processing, and response handling.
